proposals.proposal: Merge the three vendor remote access actions into one action.
proposals.rationale: All three require MFA and session logging for the same vendors on HIS and PACS (C7:HIS, C7:PACS, V2 Sample HIS vendor).

change.mergedAction: Require MFA and session logging for vendor remote access, and remove unattended remote desktop tools.

proposals.proposal: Record Ownership as a systemic root cause.
proposals.rationale: Ownership appears as a root cause in Gap Findings across GV, PR, and RS.

change.systemicStatement: No executive owns cybersecurity at CMC, so each control depends on whoever in IT has time, and no one checks whether controls work across both hospitals.
